description: Aménagements intégrant la Gestion Durable et Intégrée des Eaux Pluviales en Maine-et-Loire is a dataset listed in Data.maine-et-loire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ADOPTA. La Gestion Durable et Intégrée des Eaux Pluviales (GDIEP) est un ensemble de solutions permettant d’infiltrer la goutte d’eau au plus près d’où elle tombe afin de rétablir le cycle naturel de l’eau. Coverage: Maine-et-Loire. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are eaux pluviales, aménagement, infiltration, observatoire, GDIEP, territoire. The portal shows 25 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-01-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-maine-et-loire-fr-portal.
